label: P10_A 2%-ladder
hypothesis: Its round-1 final always came after a ~15% ask; its counters moved <= 2% from its opening (pricing committee above 2%, doc:20260310-70410-M1). An ask within 2% of its opening may be agreed or kept open, and each further step within 2% may be agreed again.

rounds.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for the 24 mm mechanical seal were at EUR 28.94 in 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31 per piece (cost:340010).

We therefore propose EUR 31.56 per piece, a change that stays within your own approval range.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you. We would like to go one step further on the commitment: we extend it to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total, which gives you planning security well beyond the 12 months you asked for in March.

In return we ask for EUR 30.93 per piece, again a step within your approval range.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you. Our framework agreement fixes prices for each calendar year and sets a standard lead time of 42 days; by accepting 56 days we give your capacity the room it needs. To close on that basis we propose EUR 30.31 per piece on the same terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you. One last step: EUR 29.89 per piece, the price we have paid since January 2024, on the same 36-month, 56-day terms. We are ready to sign on this today.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
